The invitation

Welcome, epic being.

You have been invited to join us this Halloween for a truly transformational gathering we call Beyond the Veil.

On the 31st of October, as the sun goes down and the veil between worlds thins, a gate will open in the hills of Lakeway to an estate that will become our playground.

For centuries, people have gathered at this time of year to mark the turning from harvest to winter and to honor those who came before. Disguises were worn as a way to walk between worlds, to become someone else for one night and pass unrecognized among the spirits.

This year, we're giving you a permission slip to wear a disguise that does the opposite. Create a costume that celebrates the bigness of your expression.

This event is your canvas, and your gifts are the paint. Be bold, be wild, and play BIG!!

Inside the gates, every expression is honored: your movement, your voice, your dance, and your vibration.

As we move beyond the veil, let the friction fall away, let your “try” die, and let your gifts live.

Everything you need to walk between worlds is below: the flow of the night, inspiration for your costume, and how to get your tickets, rideshare, and parking. Read on, and secure your place before the gate closes.

See you on the other side,Michael & Austin Dance Temple

This isn't a show you watch or a costume contest. Everyone here is part of the art, and there's room for you to make some.

The Flow

  1. 7:00 to 8:00 PM

    The Arrival

    Doors open at 7 and close at 8. Check in and find your people.

  2. 8:00 to 8:30 PM

    The Gathering

    Photos, then everyone gathers outside.

  3. 8:30 PM

    The Crossing

    The opening ceremony, led by Leah Free, sets the agreements for the whole night. Be there for it.

  4. 9:00 PM to sunrise

    The Night

    Two stages run until morning, with performances between the sets. At 2 AM the clocks fall back, and Halloween gives us an extra hour.

  5. Sunrise, about 6:45 AM

    First Light

    Sunshine plays the sunrise set as the sun comes up over the hills.

Before You Cross

  • 21 and overBring your ID.
  • Alcohol-freeGrazing table, non-alcoholic drinks and water provided.
  • Doors close at 8 PMBe settled for the 8:30 ceremony.
  • No re-entryOnce you're inside, you're inside.
Who is this for?

Couples, singles, friends, collaborators, and anyone arriving as a new version of themselves. Every guest must be 21 or older.

What kind of night is it?

A party that's sexy, wild and wholesome all at once, held within clear boundaries and mutual respect. We never repeat a night, so please don't assume what this one holds based on past events. Our only promise is intention, craft and a few surprises.

When should I arrive?

Doors open at 7 PM and close at 8 PM. The opening ceremony begins outside at 8:30, and it sets the agreements for the whole night, so be there for it.

Can I leave and come back?

No. There's no re-entry once you're inside.

Is there alcohol, and what's there to eat?

This is an alcohol-free night. We'll have a grazing table, non-alcoholic drinks and water, plus tea service by Casa Akasha.

Where is it?

A private estate in the hills of Lakeway. The address is shared with ticket holders in the guide, which opens with the code in your Partiful invite.

How do I get there?

Rideshare or arrange a drop-off. The ticket-holder guide links to a rideshare group so you can share cars with other guests. Parking passes are limited and sold at checkout for $50 per car. Never park on the road leading in: cars there will be towed, and guests who walk in from the road will be turned away.

Can I take photos?

A videographer will film the opening ceremony. Some spaces are camera-free, and we ask you to respect them.

Can I get a refund or transfer my ticket?

Yes. Refunds and transfers to a friend are both allowed. Email us and we'll take care of it.

What if it sells out?

A waitlist opens. You can also nominate as many people as you like for the guest list.

What about shoes?

Costume shoes may stay on. Everyday shoes come off inside the house.

Can I bring my pet?

Please leave pets at home, and treat the property, art and furnishings with care.

Anything else I should know?

By attending, you agree to honor consent, clear communication and the people around you. If you need help at any point, find any member of our team.

Still wondering? Email beyondtheveil.atx@gmail.com. Please don't text the producers directly.

Nominate a Guest

Know someone who belongs on the other side?

Tell us about them. Every nomination is read by our team, and you can nominate as many people as you like. A nomination is not an invitation: if your nominee is selected, we'll reach out to them directly, usually within 48 hours.
